name: Google Contacts pull
description: Bidirectional Google Contacts sync through the connection broker: people land through merge-aware staging, and explicit local edits queue versioned write-back.
prompt: Every six hours, pull my Google Contacts into the vault as people. Follow the sync token incrementally after the first full walk. Stage inbound changes for review; dedupe by email and phone, and send explicit local edits back with provider-version conflict protection.

vault.why: Stages Google Contacts into the vault's review band as people and tracks the incremental syncToken cursor on the pull.gcontacts connection.
